falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4200 at any point in the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A break of the August 2024 low pattern structure invalidates the 76% bottom similarity; the presumed support floor has failed and this is not a comparable bottoming formation

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for 2 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Blowoff score of 40 implies controlled fear/peak anxiety; sustained VIX above 35 indicates panic escalation rather than blowoff exhaustion, proving the pattern is not bottoming but entering new liquidation phase

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops below 3.80% while S&P 500 is also down >2% on the same day
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Flight-to-safety bid with simultaneous equity dump signals recession/depression pricing, not a cyclical bottom; invalidates the bottom_2024_aug pattern which occurred in a soft-landing/rate-cut pricing regime

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
